questions.question: Whom did Moses publicly commission to lead Israel?
What did Moses do with the written law?
options: Gave it to the priests and Levites to keep by the ark
Burned it after reading it aloud to the people
Hid it in a cave for a later generation to find
Kept it secret from all but the chief elders
questions.answer: Gave it to the priests and Levites to keep by the ark

questions.question: Moses told Israel to read the law publicly every seven years at the Feast of Booths.
Moses encouraged Joshua, "Be strong and _____; do not fear."
Moses wrote this _____ and gave it to the priests to place beside the ark.
